H4006.def: the same as «04005»; Mibchar, an Israelite:--Mibhar.

H4007.def: or mebbat {meb-bawt'}; from «05027»; something expected, i.e. (abstractly) expectation:--expectation.

H4008.def: from «0981»; a rash utterance (hasty vow):--(that which ...) uttered (out of).

H4009.def: from «0982»; properly, a refuge, i.e. (objective) security, or (subjective) assurance:--confidence, hope, sure, trust.

H4012.def: from «01129»; built up; Mebunnai, an Israelite:--Mebunnai.

H4013.def: also (in plural) feminine (Dan. 11:l5) mibtsarah {mib-tsaw-raw'}; from «01219»; a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively, a defender:--(de-, most) fenced, fortress, (most) strong (hold).

H4014.def: the same as «04013»; Mibtsar, an Idumaean:--Mibzar.

H4017.def: from the same as «01314»; fragrant; Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite:--Mibsam.

H4019.def: from the same as «01378»; stiffening; Magbish, an Israelite, or a place in Palestine:--Magbish.

H4021.def: from the same as «01389»; a cap (as hemispherical):--bonnet.

H4022.et: from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent
H4022.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent; properly, a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as a product or fruit:--pleasant, precious fruit (thing).

H4023.def: (Zech. «012» or Mgiddow {meg-id-do'}; from «01413»; rendezvous; Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine:--Megiddo, Megiddon.

H4024.def: or Migdol {mig-dole'}; probably of Egyptian origin; Migdol, a place in Egypt:--Migdol, tower.

H4025.def: from «04022» and «0410»; preciousness of God; Magdiel, an Idumaean:--Magdiel.

H4026.def: also (in plural) feminine migdalah {mig-daw- law'}; from «01431»; a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers:--castle, flower, tower. Compare the names following.

H4027.def: from «04026» and «0410»; tower of God; Migdal-El, a place in Palestine:--Migdal-el.

H4028.def: from «04026» and «01408»; tower of Fortune; Migdal-Gad, a place in Palestine:--Migdal-gad.

H4029.def: from «04026» and «05739»; tower of a flock; Migdal-Eder, a place in Palestine:--Migdal-eder, tower of the flock.

H4030.def: from the same as «04022»; preciousness, i.e. a gem:--precious thing, present.

H4031.def: from «01463»; Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region:--Magog.

H4032.et: from (01481) in the sense of fearing
H4032.def: or (Lam. 2:22) maguwr {maw-goor'}; from «01481» in the sense of fearing; a fright (objective or subjective):--fear, terror. Compare «04036».

H4033.def: or magur {maw-goor'}; from «01481» in the sense of lodging; a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence:--dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare «04032».

H4035.def: feminine of «04032» or of «04033»; a fright; also a granary:--barn, fear.

H4036.et: from (04032) and (05439) with the preposition inserted
H4036.def: from «04032» and «05439» with the preposition inserted; affright from around; Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolic name of Pashur:--Magor-missabib.

H4037.def: from «01504»; a cutting implement, i.e. a blade:--axe.

H4038.et: from an unused root meaning to reap
H4038.def: from an unused root meaning to reap; a sickle:--sickle.

H4041.def: from the same as «01571»; properly, accumulation, i.e. impulse or direction:--sup up.

H4042.def: a denominative from «04043»; properly, to shield; encompass with; figuratively, to rescue, to hand safely over (i.e. surrender):--deliver.

H4043.def: also (in plural) feminine mginnah {meg-in-naw'}; from «01598»; a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile:--X armed, buckler, defence, ruler, + scale, shield.

H4044.def: from «04042»; a covering (in a bad sense), i.e. blindness or obduracy:--sorrow. See also «04043».

H4046.def: from «05062»; a pestilence; by analogy, defeat:--(X be) plague(-d), slaughter, stroke.

H4047.def: apparently from «01479» or «05062» and «06211»; exterminator of (the) moth; Magpiash, an Israelite:--Magpiash.

H4048.def: a primitive root; to yield up; intensively, to precipitate:--cast down, terror.

H4051.def: from «04048»; precipice; Migron, a place in Palestine:--Migron.

H4052.def: from «01639»; a ledge or offset:--narrowed rest.

H4053.def: from «01640»; something thrown off (by the spade), i.e. a clod:--clod.

H4054.def: also (in plural) feminine (Ezek. 27:28) migrashah {mig-raw-shaw'}; from «01644»; a suburb (i.e. open country whither flocks are driven from pasture); hence, the area around a building, or the margin of the sea:--cast out, suburb.

H4055.def: or med {made}; from «04058»; properly, extent, i.e. height; also a measure; by implication, a vesture (as measured); also a carpet:--armour, clothes, garment, judgment, measure, raiment, stature.

H4057.et: from (01696) in the sense of driving
H4057.def: from «01696» in the sense of driving; a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs):--desert, south, speech, wilderness.

H4058.def: a primitive root: properly, to stretch; by implication, to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively, to be extended:--measure, mete, stretch self.

H4060.def: feminine of «04055»; properly, extension, i.e. height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically, tribute (as measured):--garment, measure(-ing, meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide.

H4061.def: (Aramaic) or mindah (Aramaic) {min-daw'}; corresponding to «04060»; tribute in money:--toll, tribute.

H4062.def: perhaps from the equivalent of «01722»; goldmaking, i.e. exactness:--golden city.

H4063.et: from an unused root meaning to stretch
H4063.def: from an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, extent, i.e. measure; by implication, a dress (as measured):--garment.

H4066.def: from «01777»; a contest or quarrel:--brawling, contention(-ous), discord, strife. Compare «04079», «04090».

H4067.def: from the same as «04063»; extensiveness, i.e. height:--stature.

H4068.def: the same as «04067»; Madon, a place in Palestine:--Madon.

H4069.et: from (04100) and the pass. participle of (03045)
H4069.def: or madduaa {mad-doo'-ah}; from «04100» and the passive participle of «03045»; what (is) known?; i.e. (by implication) (adverbially) why?:--how, wherefore, why.

H4070.def: (Aramaic) or mdor (Aramaic) {med-ore'}; or mdar (Aramaic) {med-awr'}; from «01753»; a dwelling:--dwelling.

H4071.et: from (01752) in the sense of accumulation
H4071.def: or mdurah {med-oo-raw'}; from «01752» in the sense of accumulation; a pile of fuel:--pile (for fire).

H4074.def: of foreign derivation; Madai, a country of central Asia:--Madai, Medes, Media.

H4075.def: patrial from «04074»; a Madian or native of Madai:--Mede.

H4078.def: from «04100» and «01767»; what (is) enough, i.e. sufficiently:--sufficiently.

H4080.def: the same as «04079»; Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants:--Midian, Midianite.

H4082.def: from «01777»; properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region:--(X every) province.

H4084.def: patronymical or patrial from «04080»; a Midjanite or descend. (native) of Midjan:--Midianite. Compare «04092».

H4086.def: from the same as «01828»; dunghill; Madmen, a place in Palestine:--Madmen.

H4087.def: feminine from the same as «01828»; a dunghill:--dunghill.

H4088.def: the same as «04087»; Madmenah, a place in Palestine:--Madmenah.

H4089.def: a variation for «04087»; Madmannah, a place in Palestine:--Madmannah.

H4091.def: the same as «04090»; Medan, a son of Abraham:--Medan.

H4093.def: or maddai {mad-dah'}; from «03045»; intelligence or consciousness:--knowledge, science, thought.

H4095.et: from an unused root meaning to step
H4095.def: from an unused root meaning to step; properly, a step; by implication, a steep or inaccessible place:--stair, steep place.

H4096.def: from «01869»; a treading, i.e. a place for stepping on:--(foot-)breadth.

H4097.def: from «01875»; properly, an investigation, i.e. (by implication) a treatise or elaborate compilation:--story.

H4098.def: from «01758»; a threshing, i.e. (concretely and figuratively) down-trodden people:--threshing.

H4099.def: of Persian origin; Medatha, the father of Haman:--Hammedatha (including the article).
